note:
staging takes 1.4.4. One release is crossed, 1.4.3 to 1.4.4, and nothing is
skipped, so no skipped release carries a landing section anybody has to read.

The releases: class fix, disruption quiet. No core floor moves. Codex stays at
0.147.0 and Claude stays at 2.1.227, the same values 1.4.3 declared.

The box, measured on staging at 14:07Z before this note was written:
claw-members holds one person, that person's persistent core is installed and
reads 2.1.227, which meets the floor. No member reads as below a floor, so this
claw's own classifier will not defer the release to the quiet window.

From this release a firm's own skills in the machine-wide tier survive an apply.
The run removes only the entries its own ledger names, which is
/etc/commonclaw/skills.yaml, and it leaves everything else where it is with one
line naming the full path. A name a firm already uses beats the shipped skill of
that name, and the run says which name that happened to.

From this release the updater can ride a named release attended. The command is
commonclaw-update.sh --release <tag>, run as root from a person's own shell. It
refuses unless a tier at or below this claw's own already carries the tag, and it
refuses when no terminal is on stdin or systemd started the run, so neither the
timer nor systemctl start can ride it.
